findings.highlight: it’s so cold that it started snowing
findings.evidenceJa: 寒い寒い、雪降ってきた
findings.governingReading: Cold, cold—the snow has started falling
findings.explanation: Two observations are converted into a direct causal claim that cold temperature made the snow begin.

findings.highlight: There’s commotion as Fuji-nee comes home
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃーす、とばかりに藤ねえが帰ってきた
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee comes home with the air of a breezy “Hey, all”
findings.explanation: A characterization of Taiga’s casual entrance becomes unsupported noise or disturbance.

findings.evidenceJa: お気に入りのバームクーヘン
findings.explanation: Taiga’s specific favorite cake disappears, weakening the deliberately prolonged beat before she notices Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつにあの笑顔をされると気圧される
findings.governingReading: When she gives me that smile, I feel overawed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s personal familiarity with Rin’s intimidating smile becomes a generic second-person observation.

findings.evidenceJa: この程度の感覚のズレ
findings.explanation: Shirou’s precise recognition that proprioception is misaligned becomes a vague “problem.”

findings.highlight: I put a towel below me
findings.evidenceJa: 床にバスタオルを敷いた
findings.governingReading: I spread a bath towel over the floor
findings.explanation: The protective towel’s concrete placement beneath the dishes becomes placement beneath Shirou himself.
